note: Family-owned RV resort 4.5 km south of the Village of Pigeon Lake, beside Dorchester Ranch Golf Course: mostly seasonal sites in mature forest, with two fenced wagon-wheel group areas whose pull-through sites are also rented singly, a few overflow dry sites and a heated outdoor pool. --Claude
summary: Operator rates page (July 2026) and Campspot read: base C$32 + GST overflow dry site (C$47 30-amp group-area sites), C$6.95 Campspot fee, 50-ft pull-throughs, opens May 1. DROP CANDIDATE: Campspot 3.9 from 31 ratings (Google 4.3/64); mostly seasonal (140 seasonal, ~20 nightly sites, ~12%).

Google Maps: 4.3 from 64 reviews, phone +1 780-586-2249, website fireflyandfiddle.com. No --AWH note.

LONG-STAY / SEASONAL (borderline, read as mostly seasonal): the home page: 'we have 140 full serviced seasonal sites. There are 2 group sites available for rent to either individual campers or groups ... Additionally, there is a premium pool site and several unserviced, dry camping sites available.' Campspot sells 6 + 7 group-area pull-throughs, 3 overflow, 1 cookhouse and 1 pool site nightly (plus a 'Deluxe Full Hookup' type with 0 sites listed) - about 18-20 nightly sites of ~160 (~12%), so test 4 (1 in 10) passes narrowly. Test 1 (nights really for sale): passes (Campspot quotes). Test 2 (posted nightly rate): passes (C$47 daily, C$32 dry). Test 3 (standing minimum): none found. Test 5 (home community): annual leases ('ANNUAL LEASE **Limited Sites Available**', C$3,340 + GST a season) but no homes sold. The operator leads with 'overnight RV camping and seasonal sites'. With the Campspot 3.9 this fits the 'under 4 stars plus borderline mostly seasonal' automatic-drop pattern.

PRICE GATE (private): base C$32 + GST (overflow dry site, pull-through, Campspot quote; the cheapest site a 23-ft motorhome can book); C$47 + GST for 30-amp power/water. Passes C$69. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: Edmonton 79 km).
